invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.hint: VAT invoices from KaamSathi. Download the PDF for your records.
invoices.empty_body: Invoices are issued after the end of each B.S. month for that month's charges.
invoices.plan_formula: {base} per month includes {included} workers, then {rate} per extra active worker. Minimum {min}.
invoices.change_plan_hint: To change your plan, contact KaamSathi support.

ops_billing.title: Billing
ops_billing.subtitle: Invoices, payments, credit notes and price plans.
ops_billing.rules_note: Employers and partners are billed — never workers. Issued invoices get a gap-free number per B.S. fiscal year (KS-2083/84-000001); correct them with a credit note, not an edit.
ops_billing.generate_hint: Creates one draft per employer/partner from unpaid charges up to the chosen B.S. month. Rerunning adds new charges to existing drafts.
ops_billing.generated: {count, plural, =0 {No new invoices} one {# draft invoice ready} other {# draft invoices ready}}
ops_billing.empty_body: Generate drafts for a month to start.
ops_billing.void_hint: Only invoices without payments can be voided. The number stays used.
ops_billing.plans_hint: Monthly charge = max(base + active workers above included × per-worker rate, minimum). Changes apply from the next subscription charge.
ops_billing.plan_formula_hint: Changes apply from the next monthly charge.
ops_billing.subscriptions_hint: Organizations without a plan are on Pilot. Changing the plan affects the next monthly charge.

ops_analytics.title: Product analytics
ops_analytics.subtitle: First-party funnels and retention from in-app events.
ops_analytics.privacy_note: No personal data is collected: events carry only allow-listed, non-identifying properties. Counts under 5 are hidden (k-anonymity). Raw events are deleted after 400 days.

funnel_desc.worker_onboarding: Worker profiles created → ID uploaded → verified → shortlisted → placed.
funnel_desc.employer_activation: Organizations created → first job published → first placement → first hajiri → first payroll approved.

ops_analytics.retention_desc: Users grouped by the week of their first event; share active in each later week.
ops_analytics.k_note: Cells based on fewer than {k} people are hidden.
